title: Night
author: Elie Wiesel
summary: Elie Wiesel recounts being deported as a teenager from his Hungarian town to Auschwitz and Buchenwald, and the loss of his family and his faith. It is a short, spare testimony of the Holocaust.
readIf: you want a brief, direct first-person account of the Holocaust that stays with you.
skipIf: you are not ready for sustained, unrelieved descriptions of cruelty and death.
